Settings

Where the ichava packs live

Directories holding the pack checkouts (icon-sets-tabler/, icon-sets-openmoji/…), searched in order. packages_dirs in the global config; --packages-dir and ICHAVA_PACKAGES_DIRS override it.

None set: packs are found through workspace, /work, or beside this checkout.

Effective settings

Highest first: flags, then ICHAVA_* environment, then the global config, then a pack's own settings, then defaults. This is config print --origins for the run as a whole; a pack's page shows its own layer merged in. Saving a value here writes it to the global config, kept in its history; Reset removes it from there, so the next layer down applies. The environment and flags belong to the process that started this server, so the page cannot change them.

Integrations

The REST API, the event stream, webhooks and the MCP server. Each is off until its switch here is on, and turning one on takes effect when the server next starts. API tokens and webhook secrets never live in the global config: icon-sets-sync api token create and icon-sets-sync webhooks add make them, show them once and keep them in the state directory. See docs/tools/api.md, webhooks.md and mcp.md.

from default

Default: false.
from default
also serve the API when serve binds beyond loopback (--allow-remote); without it a remote server has no API
Default: false.

1 to 10000. Default: 60.
from default
auto terminates TLS whenever serve binds beyond loopback (with api.tls_cert and api.tls_key, else a generated self-signed certificate); off-behind-proxy serves plain HTTP there, for a TLS proxy in front
Default: auto.
from default

Default: –.

Default: –.
from default

Default: false.
from default

Default: false.
from default

Default: [].

Default: false.

Where the configs live

Pack configs
The registry (packs.json) and one config per pack: its upstream, its recipe and where its checkout is. Not settings.
/work/config
Order: --config-dir, ICHAVA_CONFIG_DIR, config/ beside the binary, the checkout around the working directory, then the configs built into the binary.

Your settings for every run on this machine: the values in the table, and nothing about packs.

Precedence
For each setting, the first layer that sets it wins: --set and flags, then ICHAVA_* environment, then the global config, then a pack's own settings, then the defaults. Each setting's "from" badge names the layer.
